hero.title: Full Stack Developer focused on building modern and scalable applications
hero.intro: Hi, I'm <strongName>Cristofe Albuquerque</strongName>. I build end-to-end solutions — bridging fluid interfaces in <strongTech>Next.js</strongTech> with robust <strongTech>NestJS</strongTech> backends, relational databases, and production deployments.

hero.title: Full-stack developer. Frontend foundation
hero.intro: I’m Cristofe Albuquerque, a developer with a frontend foundation who builds fast, secure, and sustainable applications — from interface to deployment.

about.title: Software engineering focused on architecture, security, and real-world production.
about.p1: My core foundation is in frontend engineering, crafting fast, responsive, and polished interfaces with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
about.p2: Building on this foundation, I work across the full stack: creating structured NestJS APIs, modeling PostgreSQL databases, and managing Docker deployments on Linux and cloud servers.
about.p3: I focus on clean code, well-defined data contracts with Zod, and decoupled architectures that keep codebases easy to maintain.
